props.body: We're a family here. Can you cover Saturday?

props.text: I can't this Saturday, but I can help plan coverage on Friday.

frames.text: Your boss says *"We're a family here."*
Translation: *we'll ask for loyalty* we may never give back.
A family wouldn't guilt you into Saturday. *You're allowed to say no.*
Follow so this finds you again *when you need it.*
frames.sub: Send this to the coworker who's "family" every weekend.
